hero.headline: Cybersecurity Solutions
hero.subheadline: Comprehensive security solutions engineered to protect your organization at every layer

solutions.title: Next-Gen Firewall & Network Security
solutions.shortDescription: Enterprise-grade network perimeter protection combining stateful inspection, intrusion prevention, and advanced threat detection to secure your entire network infrastructure.
keyBenefits: Deep packet inspection and application-layer filtering
Intrusion Prevention System (IPS) with real-time signatures
Zero-day threat protection via sandbox analysis

solutions.title: Cloud Security & CASB
solutions.shortDescription: Secure your cloud environments across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud with unified visibility, policy enforcement, and compliance controls through our Cloud Access Security Broker platform.
keyBenefits: Data Loss Prevention (DLP) for cloud workloads
Cloud workload protection and posture management

solutions.title: Identity & Access Management
solutions.shortDescription: Enforce zero-trust principles with comprehensive IAM solutions covering multi-factor authentication, privileged access management, and identity governance across your entire enterprise.

solutions.title: Endpoint Detection & Response
solutions.shortDescription: Advanced endpoint protection platform combining next-gen antivirus, behavioral analytics, and automated response to stop sophisticated attacks before they impact your business.

solutions.title: GRC & Compliance Management
solutions.shortDescription: Streamline your governance, risk, and compliance programs with automated frameworks aligned to ISO 27001, NIST, PCI-DSS, NCA ECC, and other international standards.

solutions.title: Threat Intelligence Platform
solutions.shortDescription: Stay ahead of adversaries with curated, actionable threat intelligence feeds integrated directly into your security stack for proactive threat hunting and rapid incident response.
keyBenefits: Global threat intelligence feeds and IOC enrichment
Integration with SIEM and SOAR platforms
